entities.summary: Inter&Co Stadium is a soccer-specific stadium in downtown Orlando, Florida. The stadium is located along West Church Street in the Parramore neighborhood west of downtown Orlando. It is the home of Orlando City SC, which entered Major League Soccer (MLS) as an expansion franchise in 2015, National Women's Soccer League (NWSL) club the Orlando Pride, and United Football League franchise Orlando Storm. The stadium was completed in time for Orlando City's home opener of the 2017 season on March 5 and it became the first venue to permanently host MLS, NWSL, and United Soccer League teams all in the same location that year.

historicalSignificance.significanceNarrative: The Inter&Co Stadium's completion in time for Orlando City's home opener in 2017 marked a significant milestone for Major League Soccer (MLS) and women's soccer in the United States, as it became the first venue to permanently host MLS, National Women's Soccer League (NWSL), and United Soccer League teams all in the same location.
